questions.question: Which medications are currently prescribed, and when were they first started?
Were any medications stopped, held or changed recently, and what was the reason?
What allergies or adverse reactions are documented, and when were they first recorded?
Are there any outstanding follow-ups, referrals or tests mentioned in earlier entries?
What was the clinical rationale for continuing current medications, and was it based on recent assessment?
Was a three-month review previously scheduled or discussed, and has it been done before?
